items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; not expected to play per reports. McVay indicates possible return next week vs Eagles barring setback.
items.why: Missed practice, hip/groin; official doubtful listing.
items.implication: Heavy target/route share shift to Davante Adams.
items.opportunity: Adams elevated routes/targets (historically 42% target rate on routes without Nacua).

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Sunday at Indy.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week, official out.
items.implication: Elevated TE/WR targets in HOU offense.
items.opportunity: Schultz saw 28-30% target share/routes last week without Collins; Colts allow high TE yards.

items.text: Jayden Daniels ruled OUT; Mariota to start. Positive longer-term notes, not IR, surgery not on table.
items.why: Elbow dislocation; official out, good longer-term prognosis per Rapoport.
items.implication: WAS pass game volume/efficiency hit short-term; McLaurin historical with Mariota noted.

items.text: Rico Dowdle ruled OUT (toe) vs CIN.
items.why: Toe injury; DNP, official out. Coach: Warren will lead the group.
items.implication: Clear lead RB role for Warren with checkdown upside.
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries + pass-game work; backups Homer/Heidenreich.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report, ACTIVE/good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman OUT.
items.implication: DEN RB committee healthy; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN; clarity hoped on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR projections as of now despite Q tags.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; monitor.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN/ACTIVE.
items.implication: Full roles expected; Etienne still limited snap/third-down share historically.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate.
With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RBs; expect heavy checkdowns as vertical game failed for Rodgers. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in. Backups Homer + Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach confirms lead role; usage data + scheme fit for checkdowns.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside in PPR; volume spike.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + high route/target share potential.

items.text: Davante Adams 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted 42%; prior games without him produced big lines (e.g. 8-195-2).
Jonathon Brooks expected IR (limited career games); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.implication: Hubbard locked RB2/flex with lead backfield.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.

LOVE Chase Brown (@PIT, 20+ touches/15% targets, PIT soft vs RBs), Chris Olave (vs LV, 10+ tgts, high aDOT/air yards, LV allows 18.7 YPR), Christian Watson (vs ATL, high util/RZ share), Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% tgt share sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs).
items.why: Usage + matchup data per Love list.

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough run D), Travis Etienne (vs LV, only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, elite WR D + low WAS total).
items.opportunity: Henderson rising snaps post-Stevenson fumble (but still ranks Stevenson ahead).
